question: Does a Dr.VLA-statistics-based feature selector predict closed-loop single-feature ablation effects on this frozen OpenVLA/SAE better or worse than the existing selectors?
not_claimed: literal reproduction of Dr.VLA's trained SAE or published classifier
generality or semantic interpretability established by success-rate drops
new model or original dataset collection required by this protocol

temporal_cache.source: existing pinned dense tensors and complete forward index
temporal_cache.time_scope: all recorded consecutive policy decision steps, not the 8-step Head subsample
temporal_cache.encoding: frozen SAE FP32 encoding with original-forward grouping, following the existing readout parity protocol
temporal_cache.token_scope: seven final prediction readouts per decision step, dimension indices 0 through 6
temporal_cache.temporal_latent: arithmetic mean of the seven encoded readout vectors; encode first, aggregate second
temporal_cache.retain: all nonzero latents losslessly; no top64 truncation
temporal_cache.declaration: readout-based Dr.VLA-statistics adaptation, not the original mean-pooled-hidden SAE representation

statistics: episode coverage: fraction of episodes with any positive temporal latent
mean onset count: hysteresis onset count, averaged over active episodes
mean activation magnitude: per-episode maximum, averaged over active episodes
relative run length: active-state timestep fraction divided by onset count, averaged over active episodes
drvla_source.zero_onset_active_episode: undefined relative run length; flag and exclude from combined classifier ranking rather than silently divide or impute
drvla_source.reason: SAE input normalization, token representation and latent magnitude scale differ; raw coefficient transfer is not a validated generality predictor

calibrated_comparator.name: drvla_statistics_readout_recalibrated_v1
calibrated_comparator.labels: general versus episode-specific/memorized, judged from discovery activation traces and videos; never from closed-loop drop labels
calibrated_comparator.label_target: 30 unambiguous features, 15 per class, following discovery-only visual screening; fail gate if unavailable
calibrated_comparator.uncertain_label: exclude and disclose; never infer from intervention success
calibrated_comparator.judging: labels must be produced without consulting Head-KL rank or outcome table; identify evaluator and report any inability to blind
calibrated_comparator.model: StandardScaler plus L2 logistic regression, C=1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=1000, random_state=20260927
calibrated_comparator.fit_scope: scaler and classifier on the labeled calibration features only
calibrated_comparator.generality_validation: leave-one-feature-out diagnostics with scaler refit inside each fold; descriptive given small, visually selected calibration set
calibrated_comparator.rank_by: finite logistic decision function descending to avoid saturated probability ties
calibrated_comparator.declaration: recalibrated statistics baseline; not the published classifier or an unbiased estimate of general-feature prevalence

selection.universe: original 32768 SAE feature IDs; unsupported or undefined temporal statistics explicitly excluded and counted
selection.existing_score_vectors: retain frozen vectors; do not overwrite or retrospectively optimize them
selection.information_budget_disclosure: existing Head samples 8 steps per episode while temporal Dr.VLA statistics require the whole sequence; same episodes does not mean equal step/token support or equal offline cost
selection.existing_16_feature_panel: first analysis is restricted-panel and exploratory; no global superiority claim
selection.new_top3_coverage: report intersection and missing feature IDs against existing 16; never substitute measured lower-ranked features

evaluation.primary: mean signed success-rate drop across each method's actual global Top-3, only when all three are measured under a matched protocol
secondary: Spearman on an explicitly named common measured panel
candidate coverage and offline computation costs
evaluation.paired_cases: same task, exact initial state, seed and runtime protocol; raw and edit compared pairwise
evaluation.uncertainty: paired resampling of initial states within fixed tasks; preserve shared resample across features and methods; report fixed-panel scope
evaluation.missing_candidate_outcomes: unavailable, not zero; new rollout requires a separate costed plan and explicit approval
evaluation.old_raw_reuse: only with verified exact protocol compatibility; otherwise rerun raw/identity with new conditions
evaluation.semantic_claim: not supported by success-rate drops alone; requires separate phase/dose/matched-perturbation diagnostics

gates_and_decision.existing_data_feasibility_audit: completed; exact temporal metrics not available from the current short/truncated caches
gates_and_decision.reencode_existing_dense: next bounded computational step; execution estimate and approval before large download/compute
consider_new_data_when: a separate clean, prospective validation is justified after the comparator is defined
existing pinned source tensors or forward mappings fail reconstruction/integrity checks
gates_and_decision.clean_future_study: save restorable initial-state bytes plus hashes, full runtime/checkpoint identity and seeds; split SAE fitting/discovery/final evaluation before fitting; freeze all ranks before new outcomes
gates_and_decision.legacy_limit_remains: new hashes cannot attest to unrecorded historical collection states
